The '''Medical Circle''', also known as the '''Med Circle''',<ref name="TFFT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Fight for Truth]]''</ref> was a section of the primary [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. Its purpose was to maintain the health of the planet's population.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
